tickets.title: US001 - Mobile Cafeteria Ordering
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to place cafeteria orders from my phone, so that I can reduce time spent waiting in line.

Acceptance Criteria:
- PASS if the student can select available menu items and submit an order.
- PASS if the order shows confirmed only after it is saved and received by the kitchen flow.
- PASS if unavailable items cannot be ordered.
- FAIL if an order is confirmed when fulfillment status is unknown.

tickets.title: US002 - Allergen Menu Filtering
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to filter the menu for no peanuts, so that I can avoid items that may be unsafe for my allergy.

Acceptance Criteria:
- PASS if the no-peanuts filter hides items with peanut ingredients.
- PASS if items with unknown peanut data are excluded or clearly warned.
- PASS if cross-contact risk is displayed before ordering.
- FAIL if a peanut-risk item appears as safe in filtered results.

tickets.title: US003 - Lunch Rush Special Alert
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to receive the daily special notification before the 11:30 AM lunch rush, so that I can decide whether to order early.

Acceptance Criteria:
- PASS if subscribed students receive one daily special notification before 11:30 AM.
- PASS if the notification opens the current special in the ordering flow.
- PASS if unsubscribed students receive no promotional notification.
- FAIL if sold-out specials are promoted as orderable.

tickets.title: US004 - Offline Kitchen Display
tickets.description:
As Cafeteria Staff, I want the kitchen display to keep showing accepted orders during Wi-Fi outages, so that food preparation can continue during short network interruptions.

Acceptance Criteria:
- PASS if accepted orders remain visible for at least 10 minutes offline.
- PASS if staff updates made offline are queued for synchronization.
- PASS if reconnecting does not duplicate orders.
- FAIL if the display clears accepted orders when Wi-Fi drops.

analysis.ambiguity1: Stakeholder requirement: the chef wants to mark meals as 'Sold Out' instantly from the kitchen. This is ambiguous because 'instantly' does not define acceptable propagation time, behavior when Wi-Fi is down, whether existing mobile carts are invalidated, or who is allowed to change menu availability. Developers need latency targets, offline behavior, authorization rules, and order/cart conflict handling.
analysis.ambiguity2: Stakeholder requirement: a student wants to filter the entire menu for 'No Peanuts.' This is ambiguous because it does not define whether the filter excludes only ingredients, possible cross-contact, unknown allergen data, or menu items prepared near peanuts. Developers need the allergen taxonomy, source of ingredient data, handling of unknown values, display wording, and whether the filter hides items or shows warnings.
analysis.conflictSolution: Conflict: students and marketing want mobile ordering and lunch rush notifications, while cafeteria staff report that kitchen Wi-Fi goes down for about 10 minutes daily. Confirming mobile orders during an outage could create orders the kitchen cannot see. Resolution: the server may accept an order only when it can persist the order and either confirm kitchen receipt or mark the order pending. The kitchen display must cache accepted orders for at least 10 minutes, then synchronize idempotently on reconnect. Students must see pending/unavailable status when fulfillment cannot be guaranteed.
analysis.nfr1: Offline Resilience: the kitchen display must remain usable for at least 10 minutes without Wi-Fi, showing cached accepted orders and allowing staff to continue preparing them without data loss.
analysis.nfr2: Synchronization Reliability: after connectivity returns, order and sold-out updates must synchronize idempotently within 60 seconds without duplicate orders or stale item availability.
analysis.nfr3: Allergen Safety: allergen filters must exclude items with confirmed or unknown peanut exposure data from 'No Peanuts' results and display clear warnings for cross-contact risk.
